purpose: Register the new ROUND68 execution identity for the durable construction-permit booking layer, close the claimed-but-started retry seam family, and record the ledger-correction-aware hard-cap resolver. Guards and scientific eligibility are now closed; this addendum itself constructs no environment, runs no PPO update and changes no research configuration.

science_impact.detail: run_fn, controller, environment, PPO math, GAE, mask, joint log-prob, combined advantage lambda*A_task - A_cost, ALL_ROWS, global clip, ratio clip, beta=1.00 prior, dual update, data order, world configuration, late_init_alpha=0.10, the frozen modules and the five-module checkpoint contract are all unchanged. The only changes are to identity and booking seams: which slot is charged, and what durable evidence is required before an environment constructor may run.

changes: r68_execute.py: added the durable construction-permit layer (PERMIT_REGIME=r68-construction-permit/1). _r68_atomic_run creates launch_claims/<slug>/permits/<attempt>.json in state not_issued (exclusive create + fsync) at claim time, BEFORE run_fn. _issue_permit performs an ATOMIC issuance via the exclusive creation of <attempt>.issued.json, so two competing constructions can never both hold the permit. _attempt_started never reads a missing field as a zero: the permit is authoritative when present, hook counters are the labelled legacy fallback, and the verdict records which evidence was used.

r68_execute.py: _r68_atomic_run free reuse is now permitted ONLY when the permit is explicitly not_issued AND the attempt never constructed anything AND its status is neither failed_technical nor complete. A zero-construction failure therefore books a NEW reserve attempt and the old failed claim is preserved, never overwritten. A missing permit under this regime refuses the retry outright.

r68_execute.py: _make_permit_guarded_builder wraps the LIVE r42_run counted builder (r42_run._make_counted_builder) so the permit is issued BEFORE the real environment constructor runs, a second construction for the same attempt is refused, and a construction with no active claim is refused. configure_and_inject installs it on runner.build_joint_run; the counted builder stays inside the guard.

r68_execute.py: R68Ledger.counts now separates booked attempts from ACTUAL environment constructions and reads the late-registered ledger correction exactly once. A correction slot is counted only when no reserve claim references the same (logical_job, attempt) and that attempt is complete, so a retry can never re-charge it.

r68_eval.py: _safe_atomic_run now delegates to the SHARED base._r68_atomic_run instead of keeping a second booking path. Training and evaluation therefore share one claimed-but-started rule and one construction-permit regime. persist still runs inside the success path before finish_launch; a complete-but-unsound receipt is retried on a new reserve attempt (allow_complete_retry=True) and never reused; the per-attempt run tag stays <tag>_a<attempt>.
code_change.r66x_reuse_unchanged: r68_execute still reuses only the seam-free r66 helpers (_sha256_file/_read_json/_write_json/_write_row/_reload_episode/_slot_for). _atomic_run is NOT r66x._atomic_run.

why_the_permit_layer_was_needed.frozen_builder_already_persists_before_c: runs/comm_one_shot_full_trace_ablation_20261004/r42_run.py counted_build increments environment_constructor_calls and calls write_progress BEFORE original_builder(configuration), so the happy path already leaves durable evidence.
why_the_permit_layer_was_needed.residual_seam_1_no_fsync: runs/comm_first_report_training_ablation_20261003/r40_common.py _update_claim persists with os.replace and NO fsync (unlike _write_new, which fsyncs), so a hard interruption can lose the hook write.
why_the_permit_layer_was_needed.residual_seam_2_missing_field_read_as_ze: the previous resolver inferred 'environment_constructor_calls absent therefore never constructed'. A missing field is not a zero; the permit makes the negative claim explicit and durable.
why_the_permit_layer_was_needed.residual_seam_3_two_booking_paths: r68_eval._safe_atomic_run was a second, independently maintained booking path that never went through the fixed helper, so a fix applied to training would not have covered evaluation.

cases.A: the FROZEN r66x._atomic_run free-reuses a constructed-but-interrupted attempt (the bug)
cases.B: the FIXED helper charges a NEW reserve slot for that attempt
cases.C: a claimed-but-never-constructed attempt stays a free reuse, justified by a durable not_issued permit
cases.D: permit ISSUED but hook stats NOT refreshed (hard interruption) -> new reserve charged, never a free reuse
cases.E: a MISSING permit under the regime refuses instead of assuming never-constructed
cases.F: a ZERO-CONSTRUCTION failed_technical attempt books a new reserve and the old failure is preserved
cases.G: the REAL permit guard over the REAL r42_run counted builder: permit issued before the spied constructor is entered; second build refused; no-claim build refused
cases.H: permit issuance is atomic: the first issuance wins, the competing issuance is refused
cases.I: TRAINING and EVALUATION both reach base._r68_atomic_run through their real call paths
cases.J: the hard cap reads the late reserve correction exactly once and does not double count

cli_forward_acceptance.note: parameter_sha256 equals the seed-11 r68_init_identity post_scale_parameter_sha256, so the initial policy is unchanged by the booking-only edits.

e1_ledger_correction_carried_forward.double_count_guard: counted only when no reserve claim references the same (logical_job, attempt) and that attempt is complete
e1_ledger_correction_carried_forward.note: The correction is bookkeeping, NOT scientific eligibility. Seed-11 eligibility is re-verified separately from the committed gate/update/weight/RNG/data chain.

rng_eligibility_unchanged.finding: The run contract resets ALL RNG streams deterministically per episode, so e1's sampling-start RNG depends only on (scenario_seed=1300014, action_seed(11,1)=1845279286999982427) and is independent of episode order. Reloading e0 vs re-running it cannot change e1's RNG.
rng_eligibility_unchanged.status: inference from frozen source, not a byte comparison

guards_and_caps.note: The persistent forward-row guard refuses further charges; the new tests deliberately perform 0 model forwards, 0 optimizer steps and 0 environment constructions.

eligibility_statement: With the construction-permit regime installed on the live builder, the claimed-but-started retry family covered by pure-ledger counter-examples, and both the training and evaluation call paths proven to share one helper, the ROUND68 executor is eligible to resume the fixed training plan (3 seeds x 128 episodes = 384, then 390 eval cells) within the 774+26/800 actual-construction budget. This addendum grants no new environment or training authorization by itself, and it does not by itself establish scientific eligibility for seed 11.
